question: SK hynix parent company
markdown:
SK Hynix is a South Korean semiconductor company and the world's second-largest memory chip manufacturer, headquartered in Icheon-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is majority-controlled by SK Group through SK Square, which holds about 20.5% of shares, while foreign investors own roughly 52.3% and the National Pension Service about 8.1%. The company has 712,702,365 listed common stocks, and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won recently made his first personal purchase of SK Hynix shares.
SK Hynix is a publicly traded company majority-controlled and owned by South Korea's SK Group through its investment arm, SK Square.
SK Square holds the largest single controlling stake of approximately 20.5%.
Foreign investors own roughly 52.3% of SK Hynix's shares combined.
The National Pension Service holds about 8.1% of SK Hynix.
The total number of listed stocks for SK Hynix is 712,702,365, all consisting of common stocks.
SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won bought 3,620 shares of SK Hynix on Thursday, marking his first personal investment in the chipmaker.
SK Hynix is headquartered in Icheon-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea.
SK Hynix is a South Korean semiconductor company and the world's second-largest memory chip manufacturer.
SK Hynix makes DRAM and NAND flash memory chips.
